input: Take a beginner's calligraphy class downtown

gold.taskTitle: Take a Beginner Calligraphy Class Downtown
gold.taskDescription: Find and attend a beginner-level calligraphy class located in the downtown area.

questions.title: Which calligraphy style are you hoping to learn?
questions.description: Understanding the preferred style (e.g., modern brush, copperplate, Gothic) will narrow down which classes are the best fit.

questions.title: What is your target city or downtown area?
questions.description: Knowing the exact location will allow for a focused search of local class providers.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline or preferred start date?
questions.description: A timeframe helps prioritize classes that are currently enrolling or starting soon.

questions.title: How many sessions or hours are you willing to commit?
questions.description: Some classes are single-day workshops while others run over multiple weeks; knowing your availability shapes the options.

questions.title: What is your budget for the class and supplies?
questions.description: Class fees and required materials can vary widely; a budget helps filter realistic choices.

questions.title: Do you prefer a group class or private instruction?
questions.description: Group workshops and one-on-one lessons differ in pace, price, and social dynamic.

questions.title: Do you already own any calligraphy tools or supplies?
questions.description: Knowing whether you need a beginner supply kit helps determine if a class that includes materials is necessary.
